# `armada run`

<!-- Generated by `make docs` from the commands; do not edit. -->

[All commands](armada.md)

A run is one start of a job: now with `armada job start`, on its schedule, or
from its queue. A run with tasks has one attempt per task.

Also: `runs`.

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`armada run list`](#armada-run-list) | List a job's runs, newest first |
| [`armada run show`](#armada-run-show) | Show a run of a job, with its tasks |

## `armada run list`

List a job's runs, newest first. Finished runs beyond the job's history (5 by default)
are removed; their logs are kept for 24 hours.

```
armada run list JOB [flags]
```

Also: `ls`.

Examples:

```bash
armada run list migrate
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `-o`, `--output string` | output format: text or json (default `text`) |

## `armada run show`

Show a run of a job, with its tasks.

```
armada run show JOB RUN [flags]
```

Examples:

```bash
armada run show migrate 12   # one run, with its tasks
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `-o`, `--output string` | output format: text or json (default `text`) |
